description: Your customers see thousands of marketing messages a day. Sending emails by hand, posting one social at a time, following up with leads yourself. You're not losing because your work is bad. You're losing because the math doesn't work anymore. #DigitalMarketing #MarketingStrategy #EmailMarketing #MarketingAutomation
transcript: Your customers are getting more marketing messages in a day than your grandparents got in a year. You and your team can't compete with billion dollar companies unless you know how to work smarter. Let me explain. Everyone's email inboxes are flooded. Social feeds are saturated. SMS is split across six platform push notifications. Never stop. The average person is exposed to thousands of marketing messages a day. If you're a marketer or a business owner trying to compete with them, sending emails by hand, posting one social at a time, following up with leads manually, you're not losing because the work is bad. You're losing because math is impossible. So what's actually working right now? It's not more messages. It's intelligent volume. The right message to the right person, the right time through the right channel. Automated and running while you sleep. That means you segment customers by what they actually did. You coordinate email, SMS, and voice. All in the same flow, all running at the same time. And to make this real high level a company, we partnered with their users alone are running this playbook to send 1.86 billion messages and generate 67 million new leads every single month. That's not a platform stat. That's what operators running intelligent volume at scale are producing right now. Build a system that scales with the noise.
